preconditions.description: The number of vertices V must be between 1 and 10,000.

preconditions.expression: isinstance(adj, list) and all(isinstance(lst, list) for lst in adj)
preconditions.description: The adjacency list adj must be a list of lists.
The length of the adjacency list must equal the number of vertices V.

postconditions.expression: isinstance(stdout, list) and all(isinstance(x, int) for x in stdout)
postconditions.description: The output must be a list of integers.

postconditions.expression: all(x >= 0 and x < V for x in stdout)
postconditions.description: All elements in the output list must be valid vertex indices.

postconditions.expression: stdout == [-1] if len(stdout) == 1 and stdout[0] == -1 else len(stdout) > 0
postconditions.description: If the output list contains -1, it must be the only element; otherwise, it must contain at least one valid vertex index.
